desc: The TAPCO Glock Compensator fits Gen 3 Glock pistols. Quick and easy to install, just slide it onto the rail and screw it on to secure it. Unlike other compensators, you won't need a threaded barrel. It includes a picatinny rail so you can mount needed accessories underneath and with an integrated glass breaker. Its time to upgrade you Glock with the TAPCO Compensator.
